sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministically valid. It preserves the twin/triple applicability alternative, correctly treats other propeller counts as non-applicable, constrains every linked envelope with the required tank-top boundary and both inclusive >= 1.5 m metre quantities, uses the authoritative owners and paths, and retains all prior valid repairs.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The ship-level applicability SPARQL checks only for presence of a linked envelope and does not force that linked node to satisfy gen:TRF063EnvelopeShape; an untyped or otherwise incomplete envelope can therefore pass because the envelope shape targets only rdf:type nltl:sidePropellerStrengtheningEnvelope. Add sh:node gen:TRF063EnvelopeShape to the nltl:hasSidePropellerStrengtheningEnvelope property (while retaining the ship-to-envelope path), so every linked envelope is checked for the tank-top boundary and both >= 1.5 m metre quantities.

Remove the unnecessary sh:nodeKind sh:IRI constraints from the envelope and tank-top boundary property shapes. The verified canonical object-property ranges and requirement do not require IRIs, so these restrictions can reject valid blank-node representations and are not semantically justified. Retain the ship-to-envelope sh:node link from the prior repair, the tankTop class constraint, both >= 1.5 m decimal metre quantities, and the twin/triple applicability alternative.

Repair the metre unit IRI in gen:TRF063MetreExtentShape: qudt:M expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/M and is not the verified unit. Bind a prefix to http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ and use unit:M as the sh:hasValue for qudt:unit on both extent quantities. Retain the prior ship-to-envelope sh:node link, tankTop class constraint, and inclusive >= 1.5 decimal checks.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministically valid. It preserves the twin/triple applicability alternative, correctly treats other propeller counts as non-applicable, constrains every linked envelope with the required tank-top boundary and both inclusive >= 1.5 m metre quantities, uses the authoritative owners and paths, and retains all prior valid repairs.
